provenance.notes: Digitized from published Cytiva chromatogram figures for this 3.2/300 column (pixel-position analysis of the peak apexes against the plotted axis ticks), since Cytiva does not publish these as a numeric Ve table for this column format. Where two independent Cytiva chromatograms were available, the two readings were averaged. Treat resulting MW estimates as approximate (rough order-of-magnitude / apparent MW under these exact run conditions), not a certified calibration.
